headline: rongorongo is not a plain syllabic substitution of chant-register Rapa Nui

control_syllabic.key_recovery: 48/48 symbols, 100% tokens, seeds 1-3 on published split (SPLIT_SEED=42)
control_syllabic.warm_start_alone: 4-10/48 symbols (13-39% of tokens) - the annealer, not the frequency prior, does the work

compression_bias.finding: MLE prefers shorter emissions; all 8 planted logograms scored below wrong 1-syllable readings

control_logosyllabic.note: Phase B now runs with the solver's exact constraints (rank rule, uniqueness, line sampling)

stable_phonetic_core.note: observations, not readings; earlier 001/006-as-vowels claim withdrawn (frequency-rank artifact, see vowel_identifiability_test)

vowel_identifiability_test.conclusion: V vs CV not separable as distributional classes in Rapa Nui at this scale
